🎙
Statement
by President of Russia Vladimir Putin at the SCO Plus meeting
(Bishkek, September 1, 2026)
💬
SCO Plus meetings
have become a good tradition
. In my view, this once again confirms that the international community’s interest in our organisation’s multifaceted activities continues to grow.
Russia is open to honest, mutually beneficial cooperation
based on equality and mutual benefit, while respecting each other’s interests and values, cultures and traditions.
I consider the theme proposed by the Kyrgyz Chairmanship for today’s meeting highly relevant:
“The UN as a Key Element of a Just World Order: The Contribution of SCO Plus Countries to Building a Multipolar World”
.
☝️
There is no doubt that the UN plays, and must continue to play, a central role in world affairs
.
Let me recall that last year
the UN marked its anniversary
: eight decades ago,
our countries and peoples
,
having defeated Nazism and militarism in World War II
– and today, September 1, marks
the day in 1939 when that terrible war began
–
were able to unite, find a balance of interests and agree on the fundamental rules of interstate relations
.
These principles were enshrined in
the UN Charter
in their entirety and interconnectedness
. Since then, the UN has served as a unique platform for dialogue, diplomacy and cooperation.
***
🇺🇳
The UN’s potential remains far from fully realised
.
It is important to make efforts
to improve its effectiveness
,
broaden representation in its bodies
, including the Security Council, by giving a greater role to countries of the Global South and East, and
generally adapt the organisation to changing realities and the fundamental shifts
taking place in global politics and the economy.
We are witnessing the emergence of a new, genuinely just
#MultipolarWorld
. This process is
objective
and, frankly, as everyone already understands,
irreversible
. Many states seek to determine their own destiny, firmly defend their legitimate interests and actively participate in international affairs.
Against this backdrop, the UN’s unifying and constructive role is very much in demand
. The world organisation must undoubtedly retain its function as the principal mechanism for reconciling interests. That is precisely what it was created to be from the outset – a mechanism for reconciling interests.
The UN cannot be an organisation that advances the interests of one country or a group of countries
.I repeat: the UN must remain the primary mechanism for balancing interests, not least because no comparable mechanism exists anywhere else in the world.
❗️
The UN Charter
must continue to serve as a key source of international law
.
At the same time, alongside the UN, the architecture of a
#MultipolarWorld
naturally incorporates
new multilateral regional structures
that have emerged and gained strength in Asia, Africa and Latin America. Our
Shanghai Cooperation Organisation
is an example.

🎙
Statement
by President of Russia Vladimir Putin at the meeting of the Council of Heads of State of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation
(Bishkek, September 1, 2026)
💬
Over the past quarter century,
the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation
(
#SCO
) has come a truly long way.
Let me recall that it was established in 2001 at the initiative of six states –
Russia, China, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan
and
Uzbekistan
– and has since grown stronger and expanded, becoming one of the independent and influential centers of the emerging
#MultupolarWorld
.
Today, the SCO is effectively
the largest regional association
not only on our common Eurasian continent, but in the world as a whole. Its member states are home to
almost half of the world’s population
and account for
more than one-third of global GDP
.
The members of
the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation
actively interact in politics, the economy and the humanitarian sphere
. This cooperation helps ensure the steady and sustainable development of each of our states and contributes to an atmosphere of peace and stability, trust and cooperation across our common Eurasian continent.
✍️
I am convinced that
the substantial package of decisions
prepared for approval by the Leaders
following today’s meeting will give new impetus to our partnership
within the SCO.
***
Among the practical priorities facing the SCO, I would particularly highlight
the further strengthening of commercial ties between member states
. This brings clear benefits to all of us and genuinely contributes to steady socioeconomic growth and improved living standards.
📈
Mutual trade and investment continue to grow year after year
. For example, Russia’s trade with SCO countries
exceeded $400 billion
in 2025, while our states are increasingly using national currencies in mutual settlements. In Russia’s transactions with SCO members, their share now
exceeds 98%
.
The SCO Business Council
and
Interbank Consortium
make
a major contribution to implementing joint, mutually beneficial economic projects
. In the future,
the Development Bank
now being established within our Organisation could also join this work. In my view, it should be
as independent as possible
from the financial systems of states that use economic instruments as weapons to gain unilateral advantages in international affairs.
I believe it is in our common interest to continue pursuing
a coordinated and balanced energy policy
, as provided for in
the SCO Energy Cooperation Strategy through 2030
.
☝️
We are pleased with the highly dynamic and substantive nature of cultural and humanitarian cooperation within the SCO
. Ties between our countries are expanding in education, healthcare, environmental protection, science and youth exchanges.
The SCO University
, which brings together
more than 100 universities
from our countries, is operating successfully.
Women’s forums
are also held under the Organisation’s auspices, focusing on strengthening the role of women in public, political, business and social life.
Yesterday, we attended
the opening of the World Nomad Games
now underway in Kyrgyzstan, with representatives from many SCO countries taking part, including Russia.
Our country is ready to host the next Games in Kazan
in 2028
. We will be pleased to welcome teams from interested states.
In keeping with tradition,
we also look forward to welcoming cultural and artistic figures from SCO countries
to
the International United Cultures Forum
, which will be held in St Petersburg in late September.
🤝
I am convinced that
our joint work in Bishkek will help advance multifaceted cooperation within the SCO
in the interests of strengthening security, peaceful development and prosperity throughout Eurasia.
In this regard, dear friends, I would like to recall that today, September 1, marks
the beginning of World War II
.
We must do everything possible to prevent the provocation of armed conflicts from becoming part of international practice
. I am convinced that our work is helping move us in that direction.

item.title: ⚡️ #KievRegimeCrimes Ambassador-at-Large of the Russian Ministry of Foreign Affairs
item.description: #KievRegimeCrimes ⚡️ Ambassador-at-Large of the Russian Ministry of Foreign Affairs Rodion Miroshnik : 💬 Over the past week , Ukrainian attacks on civilian targets across Russian regions surged to nearly 1,200 strikes per day . ▪️ As a result, 53 civilians were killed, including 7 children . The highest numbers of civilian casualties were recorded in the Kherson and Belgorod Regions, the DPR, LPR and Zaporozhye Region . Ukrainian militants carried out a series of deliberate attacks on targets in densely populated areas , seeking to inflict maximum harm on civilians. Throughout the week , Ozon marketplace infrastructure came under coordinated terrorist strikes throughout the week, including attacks on logistics hubs in the Republics of Adygea and Dagestan , as well as Stavropol Territory . Kiev’s armed groups also continued their criminal strategy of energy terrorism in the Zaporozhye, Kursk and Kherson Regions , focusing on key distribution substations supplying several districts at once. Energy facilities in the DPR and LPR were also targeted. On August 24-30 , Ukrainian attacks resulted in 383 civilian casualties : 330 people were injured, including 38 minors; 53 were killed, including 7 children . Over the seven-day period , Ukrainian militants fired at least 8,382 munitions at civilian targets on Russian territory – one of the highest weekly figures since the start of the year.

item.title: 🇷🇺 Opening remarks by President of Russia Vladimir Putin during the meeting with President of Kazakhstan Kassym-Jomart Tokayev on the sidelines of the SCO Summit
item.description: 🇷🇺 🇰🇿 Opening remarks by President of Russia Vladimir Putin during the meeting with President of Kazakhstan Kassym-Jomart Tokayev on the sidelines of the SCO Summit (Bishkek, August 31, 2026) . 💬 Vladimir Putin: I am very pleased to see you again – this time on the sidelines of events related to the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation . Before we begin, I would like to personally congratulate you on the results of the Kurultai parliamentary elections. I would also like to note the high voter turnout and, most importantly, the election results, which confirm that the people of Kazakhstan support the course you have chosen for the country’s further development, strengthening its domestic political stability, advancing the economy and, on that basis, addressing a broad range of social issues and improving people’s living standards. ☝️ That is what people voted for. Our bilateral relations are developing dynamically across virtually all areas. Trade figures were solid in 2026, and trade has grown further this year. #RussiaKazakhstan

item.title: 🗓 On August 31, President of Russia Vladimir Putin attended the opening ceremony of
item.description: 🗓 On August 31, President of Russia Vladimir Putin attended the opening ceremony of the VI World Nomad Games at Bishkek Arena. Ahead of the ceremony, the Heads of delegations invited to the event were welcomed by President of Kyrgyzstan Sadyr Japarov and his wife. *** The World Nomad Games are an international sports and cultural event dedicated to preserving and promoting the traditions of nomadic civilizations . They have been held since 2014. The VI World Nomad Games will take place on September 1-6, featuring competitions in 43 traditional sports disciplines , alongside an extensive cultural program. Around 3,000 athletes representing more than 100 countries will compete. 🇷🇺 #TeamRussia is represented by more than 230 athletes from 33 Russian regions .
